# scope-fe BOM, one board (generated by `kicad/gen/gen_bom.py`; do not edit by hand)

From the root netlist `kicad/export/scope-fe.net` (443 fitted parts, 122 lines). Prices in USD for one board: LCSC ladder price at the board quantity (or the LCSC minimum order), verified on 24 Nov 2026; a non-LCSC offer (`docs/research/prices.md`) is used where it is lower. `no stock` = listed but fewer in stock than needed. Full table: `docs/bom.csv`.

## JLCPCB part classes

Column `JLC class`: `basic` = JLCPCB basic library (no per-part set-up fee), `extended` = JLCPCB extended library (set-up fee per unique extended part and order, about 3 USD each at the time of writing), `not JLC` = PCB feature or footprint-only. Source: the jlcpcb.com parts API listing of the basic library (componentLibraryType `base`, 351 parts on 24 Nov 2026; it agrees with the per-part flags in `kicad/gen/lcsc_parts.py`). Status `ok` = LCSC or JLC stock covers the board quantity (JLC assembles from its own stock; some basic parts show 0 at LCSC but millions at JLC).

| | lines | unique parts | parts placed |
|---|---|---|---|
| basic | 36 | 36 | 287 |
| extended | 59 | 58 | 156 |
| fitted part lines / unique LCSC parts | 95 | 94 | 443 |

BOM optimisation of 24 Nov 2026 (user instruction: no 0.1 % resistors unless unavoidable, JLC basic parts for caps and resistors, combine lines; SPEC decisions 25 and 26): before 103 fitted part lines / 100 unique parts, 26 basic / 74 extended, 20 resistors at 0.1 % (13 part numbers), 73.13 USD. Remaining extended passives are RF-impedance or simulated values (24.9 / 43 / 47 / 68 / 82 / 91 R, 0.5 / 1.5 / 2.2 / 3.3 pF, C0G 220 p / 470 p / 1 n, the 0402 RF beads), values with no basic part under the LM27762 R2 >= 50k rule (300k, 150k, 110k), the BUF802 bias / input network (17.8k, 4.99M), the trigger level and switch-ground dividers (8.87k, 2.7k), Rofs 24.9k (keeps the RV101 trim range symmetric), the GVA feed resistors (2.49 R) and the U603 0.1 % pair. Details: `docs/research/power-tree.md` section 12.

## LCSC verification

- Date: 24 Nov 2026. Every line with a part carries an LCSC number (column LCSC); PCB features are `n/a`.
- How: lcsc.com product-detail JSON (wmsc.lcsc.com/ftps/wm/product/detail?productCode=C...) per part: MPN, manufacturer, package, description/parameters, stock, price ladder; candidates found with the jlcpcb.com parts search (same data source); JLC library type and stock from that search. Checked per part: MPN, value, tolerance, dielectric / voltage rating, package against the board footprint, LCSC stock (column Stock) and the price at the ladder step nearest 10 pcs (column P~10).
- Generic passives: UNI-ROYAL 0402WGF 1 % thick film (JLC basic where the value exists), 0.1 % 25 ppm/K thin film only for the U603 divider (YAGEO RT0402BRD07), FH / Murata / KEMET C0G, Samsung / FH X5R-X7R; one number per value / package / rating (`kicad/gen/common.py`).

## If the budget gets tight: cheapest cuts

The board is under budget; these are the options in order of cost per USD saved, should prices move:

1. **SMA connectors** (2 x 4.68, Samtec SMA-J-P-H-ST-EM1 C5199907): generic LCSC edge-launch SMAs are 0.5-2.0 (the RF Solutions CON-SMA-EDGE-S C5356059 was out of stock on 24 Nov 2026); saves up to ~8, but needs a footprint check (1.6 mm board fit, >3 GHz rating).
2. **GVA-84+ -> TRF37D73** in the phase-strobe chains: saves ~3, but sim/strobe/RESULT.md gives only 2.15 V per line (below the 2.75 V the taps need with the 80 ps stub). Not recommended.
3. **TLV3801 -> TLV3601** (single-ended output): saves ~0.5, needs a redesign of the LVDS split. Not worth it.
4. **50k trimmer -> fixed 33.2k** (RV101): saves ~0.5 if the VOFS/LF-gain trim is done in software.
5. (Done 24 Nov 2026) the 0.1 % resistors are 1 % JLC parts except the U603 pair.
